description: This file contains unit tests for decoding various WebSocket or IPC frames into GatewayFrame objects, validating correct parsing of event, request, and unknown frames including payload content and nested parameters.

classes.name: GatewayFrameDecodeTests
classes.description: A test suite for decoding and verifying GatewayFrame structures from JSON data.

methods.name: `decodes event frame with any codable payload`
methods.description: Test that a JSON representing an 'event' frame with a payload can be correctly decoded into a GatewayFrame object and its payload content validated.

methods.name: `decodes request frame with nested params`
methods.description: Test that a JSON representing a 'request' frame with nested parameters and various data types is correctly decoded and the contents validated.

methods.name: `decodes unknown frame and preserves raw`
methods.description: Test that a JSON with an unrecognized frame type is decoded as an unknown frame, preserving the raw data for further inspection.
